spec.title: Benchmark corpus (step 5a): both engines under strict, assume and advised over the three groups
spec.description: lib/benchmark/ is new: a benchmark corpus in three groups (the 93 claims of the conformance corpus; 13 cases from four documented bugs, each with its broken and fixed version: JDK-5045582's binarySearch midpoint, FindBugs RV_ABSOLUTE_VALUE_OF_HASHCODE, Java Puzzlers' Oddity, CERT NUM00-J's overflowing range check; 12 held-out regressions written after the engines' optimizations). run.py runs every case with jvmcontract on --engine native and --engine jbmc under --gaps strict, assume and advised (the contract library, --max-trust 0), with matched settings (one harness, unwind 16, arrays up to 8, a 120 s deadline per check), and classifies each run against the expected answer as correct, correct-assuming, unsupported (with the reason), false success or false alarm. The expected answers and every witness an engine reports are checked on the JVM (Reference.java for groups 2 and 3, the conformance runner for group 1). It records wall and CPU seconds and peak memory per run (wait4, JBMC included) and writes lib/benchmark/results.json and lib/benchmark/RESULTS.md. Inline, the native engine alone over groups 2 and 3 (20 s deadline) gave 24 of 25 correct in each mode; real/bucket/fix-confined (Math.abs(hash) % b against (hash & 0x7fffffff) % b for non-negative hashes) ran out of time, which is a finding, not a failure: expect it unsupported at 120 s too. JBMC's side has not been run beyond a smoke test of five runs.
spec.expected: exits 0: no false success and no false alarm on either engine in any mode, and the JVM bears out every expected answer; RESULTS.md has a row per group, engine and mode. Unsupported runs are expected (gaps under strict, a few out of time) and are not failures.

resources.notes: about 700 runs: native ones take 0.1-3 s, except about 3 at the deadline; JBMC ones 0.3-1 s on small claims, with some arithmetic and array cases possibly at the 120 s deadline in each of the three modes
